sql: SELECT a.*,m.sm_manager_id,c.`Club Name` mapping_name,c.`SM World Club ID` world_club_id FROM `IMC Manager Assignment Global` a JOIN `IMC Manager Codex Global` m ON m.manager_id=a.manager_id LEFT JOIN `IMC Game World Club Mapping` c ON c.`Game World`=a.game_world_id AND c.`Club ID`=a.team_id WHERE m.sm_manager_id=13051324 ORDER BY a.game_world_id,a.start_date
